MISSION RYUKYU SCREEN
SITUATION OPAREA: Ryukyu Trench. A Charlie II boat is moving toward the Soviet missile line under escort.
MISSION Break the Soviet ASW screen.
EXECUTION Intercept the Charlie II before the missile line, break the screen, and exfiltrate through the withdrawal area.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Weapons release is authorized against the Charlie II and screen contacts when required.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. Companion losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
